bagPolicy.summary: Pinnacle Bank Arena allows clear bags up to 12” x 12” x 6”, one clear gallon plastic freezer bag, and small clutch purses or wallets up to 4.5” x 6.5”. Bags will be inspected prior to entry.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bag that does not exceed 12” x 12” x 6”
One clear gallon plastic freezer bag
Small clutch purse or wallet 4.5” x 6.5”
prohibited: Bags, backpacks, mesh bags, partially translucent bags, or large purses
Alcohol, drugs, illegal substances or any paraphernalia associated with drug use
Apparel with explicit wording or graphics
Audio/Video recorders, professional cameras, or tripods
Cans, glass bottles, bottles, coolers & picnic baskets
Strollers, car seats or booster seats
Weapons including pocket knives, tasers, firearms, spiked jewelry, mace/pepper spray, and personal defense items
bagPolicy.note: An exception will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection.

parking.note: Parking is available in the Festival Parking Lot north of the arena with fees ranging from $3 to $10 per event. The parking garage attached to the arena is reserved for premium seating ticket holders. Additional public parking garages are available nearby.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Pinnacle Bank Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Pinnacle Bank Arena offers a variety of food and beverage options through Legends Global, which provides tailored services for different events. The venue features 105 concession points of sale and emphasizes sustainability with initiatives like banning polystyrene foam and sourcing local products.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Wheelchair-accessible and companion seats are available at all price levels, with up to three companion tickets per wheelchair seat; say you need accessible seating when you buy. For help, email boxoffice@pinnaclebankarena.com. Wheelchair transport to and from seats is available first come, first served.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Mobile tickets are managed through Ticketmaster or AXS. Ticketmaster tickets can be added to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet, and both systems let you transfer or sell tickets.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors usually open 60 to 90 minutes before the event. Check the individual event page for the confirmed time.
